relevance.rule: A thesis's score per track is the average weight of its themes. A track is only possible when a non-secondary theme of the thesis gives it a weight of at least 'primarySupport' (secondary themes add to a score but never justify a track on their own). Shown: possible tracks scoring at least 'threshold'; the second only if it reaches 'secondRatio' x the top score; at most 'maxTracks'; none if more than 'maxTracks' tracks tie for the top. A per-thesis 'trackOverride' (with a reason) replaces the calculation; tracks: [] shows none. 'derived' weights come from tracks.json: (2 x required + 1 x elective courses carrying the theme) / the highest track. 'proposal' weights are set by hand because no course carries the theme.
